summary: Comprehensive testing of Wagering Feature completed. All 17 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tested for /join page, HostControl, PresentView, and PlayerView including wagering phase displays. All core wagering flows working: custom points_per_question, picture questions entering wagering status, wager submission capped at player score, start-answering transition, change-answer re-scoring, and score override.

issues: Shows '__presentation__' as a player name in the lobby - this is the special name used by the presentation view to join the game. Consider filtering this out from the player list display. (Known issue from previous iteration)

Picture questions automatically enter 'wagering' status before 'question' status
Start-answering endpoint properly validates game is in wagering phase

Game state is stored in-memory (not MongoDB) - intentional per requirements
WebSocket broadcasts properly update all connected clients on state changes
